title: Joint interface and field limits of triangular real Lipschitz surfaces
exact_target: For uniformly sampled real-valued triangular-lattice Lipschitz surfaces with the specified two-arc boundary values, do the distinguished interface and centered height field converge to chordal $SLE_4$ and sigma times the domain GFF? Require constants independent of the marked domain, $v=2/\operatorname{sqrt}(3)$, $\sigma ^2=1/(vA)$, $\lambda ^2=\pi /(8vA)$, and limiting mean lambda times the difference of the two boundary-arc harmonic measures.
